source.product: IKEA STOCKHOLM coffee table, walnut veneer (702.397.10)
source.dimensionsVerifiedAt: https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/stockholm-coffee-table-walnut-veneer-70239710/ (180 x 59 x 40 cm; converted from inches on the page)
source.generation: Higgsfield image_to_3d (Meshy), single reference image, should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, then gltf-transform optimize (--compress false, --texture-compress auto --texture-size 1024, --simplify --simplify-ratio 0.35) to bring an oversized PBR export (13.9MB, 30,686 triangles — over the 30k cap on its own) under budget

knownLimitations: FAILS the automated check in backend/api/test_furniture_assets.py as pushed. After fitting to the correct 40cm height, measured box is 155.5 x 40.0 x 53.1 cm against the real STOCKHOLM's 180 x 40 x 59 cm: width off by 24.5cm and depth by 5.9cm, both outside tolerance (~5.4cm / ~2cm). Single-photo reconstruction under-estimated how elongated the oval top really is — not a units/scale bug. Same failure class already flagged and accepted for the EKTORP sofa and RAMNEFJALL bed on branch codex/adelle-sofa-bed-assets; pushed anyway under the same standing direction rather than re-asking.
Generated from a single product photo, no additional angles — the woven rattan shelf underneath and thin round legs are also unverified against the real product up close
No manual Blender inspection/correction pass has been done
